propositions: VOTER_ERROR marker is emitted twice (once via logger.error and once via print to stderr) when logging is configured, causing the host observability probe to count each error twice

The root cause is that configure_logging() attaches a StreamHandler to stdout with %(message)s format, causing the logger copy to also land at line start, and journald merges stdout/stderr so the anchored grep counts both
Four sibling markers (MERGE_CHANGE_ERROR, RECONCILE_DEGRADED, ARTIFACT_EMIT_ERROR, LLM_TOKEN_USAGE) share the same dual-emission construct, doubling their metrics
The fix is to keep only the unconditional print(line, file=sys.stderr) as the single line-start emission and change logger calls to log the structured record body without the token prefix
A structural class-guard test must prevent future markers from reintroducing the dual line-start emission construct
